messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Installing plyr on OS-X?
parts:
Hi all -

I've been trying to install plyr on 2.14 with no luck.  Here's the message I get when I open a fresh session and try it (from CRAN) :

> install.packages('plyr')
trying URL 'http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/leopard/contrib/2.14/plyr_1.6.tgz'
Content type 'text/html; charset=UTF-8' length 2611 bytes
opened URL
==================================================
downloaded 2611 bytes

tar: Unrecognized archive format: Inappropriate file type or format
tar: Error exit delayed from previous errors.

The downloaded packages are in
/var/folders/kA/kA6X8OPFGi8oMhKahtOG0o106mY/-Tmp-//RtmpwCoyTo/downloaded_packages
Warning messages:
1: 'tar' returned non-zero exit code 1 
2: In file.rename(file.path(tmpDir, pkgname), instPath) :
  cannot rename file '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/file7829a53a/plyr' to '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/plyr', reason 'No such file or directory'
3: unable to move temporary installation ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/file7829a53a/plyr’ to ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/plyr’ 

When I download the source itself and install it from the terminal, everything looks like it goes through clearly :

David-Kahle:Mail Downloads david_kahle$ R CMD install plyr
* installing to library ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library’
* installing *binary* package ‘plyr’ ...

* DONE (plyr)

But then when I try to load it (again in a fresh session, after doing the terminal install) :

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/plyr/libs/x86_64/plyr.so':
  dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/plyr/libs/x86_64/plyr.so, 6): Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.13/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
  Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/plyr/libs/x86_64/plyr.so
  Reason: image not found
Error: package/namespace load failed for ‘plyr’

Ideas?  sessionInfo() below.

Thanks!
david.

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.14.0 (2011-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin9.8.0/x86_64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base
